test_commit_scheduler_push_to_hub: test the CommitScheduler class to push folder contents to a Hugging Face Hub repo at regular intervals
test_commit_scheduler_sync_folder: test the CommitScheduler class to sync a local folder to a remote Hugging Face Hub repository
test_commit_scheduler_squash_history: test the CommitScheduler class with squash_history to merge all commits into a single squashed commit
test_commit_scheduler_context_manager: test the CommitScheduler class as a context manager that auto-stops on exit
test_partial_file_io: test the PartialFileIO class to read truncated portions of files with size-limited reads
